guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.intro: OREVOSH is about clothes, not bodies. Here is what keeps it that way.
guidelines.rule1: Comments are about the outfit: fit, color, proportion, the shoes. Nothing about anyone's body, face, weight, age or gender. The stylist follows the same rule.
guidelines.rule2: You confirmed you are at least 16. Looks that appear to show a child are removed.
guidelines.rule3: Post yourself, or people who agreed to be posted. No screenshots of other people's photos, no nudity.
guidelines.rule4: A brand's own looks are marked. Product tags link to the brand's own site. Challenges are decided by votes, not by the brand.
guidelines.rule5: Three reports hide a look or a comment until a moderator has seen it. Repeat offenders are suspended.
guidelines.privacy: Your checks are private until you post them. The stylist's tip and breakdown stay yours even after you post. Delete your account in Settings and everything goes: photos, clips, looks, comments, follows.

legal.terms_intro: The short version: be 16 or over, post only your own looks, keep your rights, and let us show what you post.
legal.terms_1: OREVOSH is run by its owner ("the owner", "we"). These terms are the agreement between you and the owner for using the OREVOSH app and website ("the service"). How to reach us is at the end.
legal.terms_2: You pick where an outfit is going, add a photo or a short clip, and a stylist built on an AI model scores the look for that occasion and gives one tip. The check is private. If you post it, it joins a feed where people react, comment, save and follow, and brands can feature looks and open challenges. The stylist's verdict is an opinion about clothes, never about your body, and it can be wrong.
legal.terms_3: You have to be 16 or over; we ask your date of birth to check. One person per account, your real date of birth, and a password you keep to yourself. Browsing needs no account. A brand account is for a business posting its own looks, and it is marked as one.
legal.terms_4: Post only photos and clips of yourself, or of people who agreed. You keep every right to what you post. You give us a licence to store it, to show it in the app to the people you chose to show it to, and to use your public looks, never your private checks, in the app's own promotion for as long as they are public. Delete a look and that licence ends, except for copies people already shared outside the app.
legal.terms_5: The community guidelines are part of these terms: judge clothes, never people; no nudity, no other people's photos, no harassment, no spam. Three reports hide a look or a comment until a moderator has seen it. We can remove content and suspend or close an account that breaks the rules.
legal.terms_6: The free plan has a daily number of checks. Pro raises it and unlocks extras, for the price the app shows before you pay. Payments go through a payment provider; we never see your card. Pro renews each period until you cancel; to cancel, write to us and Pro runs to the end of the period you paid for.
legal.terms_7: The service is provided as it is. The stylist can be wrong, the app can be down, and we may change or stop features. As far as the law allows, the owner is not liable for losses from using the service or from relying on the stylist's opinion. Nothing here takes away rights the law gives you.
legal.terms_8: You can delete your account in Settings at any time; everything you posted goes with it. We can close an account that breaks these terms or the law, and we say why unless the law prevents it.
legal.terms_9: When these terms change, the version and date at the bottom change, and for anything important we tell you in the app before it takes effect. Using the service after that means you accept the new terms.
legal.terms_10: Questions about these terms: hello@orevosh.app. The law and the courts of the place where the owner is based apply.
legal.privacy_intro: The short version: your checks are private, the model provider gets the photo and nothing about you, and deleting your account deletes everything.
legal.privacy_1: For your account: your handle, a display name, bio and website if you add them, a hash of your password (never the password), your email if you add one, your date of birth, your language, your plan and, if you paid, the payment provider's customer id. For your checks: the photo or clip, the occasion and note you typed, the score and the stylist's feedback, when it happened and how long it took. For the community: your looks, captions, tags, mentions, comments, fires, saves, follows, votes, reports and notifications. On this phone: a session cookie and, if you turned notifications on, a push subscription. In the server log: the time, path and status of requests, never your photos.
legal.privacy_2_title: What we send to the model provider
legal.privacy_2: To score a look we send the AI model provider the photo you check (or the frame you picked from a clip), the occasion, your note and your language. Never your name, handle, email or date of birth. What the provider does with it is covered by its own terms.
legal.privacy_3: A check is private: only you see it, until you post it. A posted look, its score, headline and caption are public to anyone with the link, signed in or not. The tip and the breakdown stay yours. Your email and date of birth are never shown to anyone. Moderators see reported content and account status, not private checks.
legal.privacy_4: Private checks stay until you delete them or your account. A check made as a guest, before signing up, is kept for a day and then deleted unless you signed up and claimed it. Posted looks stay until you delete them. Email links expire within a day (confirmation) or an hour (password reset). Server logs are kept only as long as running the service needs.
legal.privacy_5: Settings → Delete account removes the account, every check, photo, clip, look, comment, fire, save, vote, follow and notification at once, and fixes other people's counters. Copies people shared outside the app, like a story card, are theirs.
legal.privacy_6: One session cookie keeps you signed in (90 days), one guest cookie remembers a check you made before signing up for a day, and your language is kept in your browser. No analytics, no ad trackers, no third-party cookies.
legal.privacy_7: OREVOSH is for people 16 and over. We ask the date of birth at signup and refuse younger people. If you believe someone under 16 has an account, write to us and we remove it.
legal.privacy_8: Your data lives on the server the owner runs. Photos and clips are stored privately and served only through the app, to the people allowed to see them. Passwords are hashed, connections are encrypted.
legal.privacy_9: You can see and change your profile in Settings and delete everything there. You can ask us for a copy of your data, or to correct or delete it, by writing to us. When this policy changes, the version and date change, and we tell you in the app about anything important.
